items.title: DentaCare
items.description: An admin panel for dental clinics — every screen of the design built end to end, in Russian, Kyrgyz and English, with light and dark themes.
bullets: Patients, dental chart, appointments, treatment plans, billing, inventory, reports and staff
Role-based access: users, roles and permissions with full create / edit flows
Feature-Sliced Design enforced by ESLint boundaries and Steiger
All forms, filters and search through React Hook Form + Zod
items.tech: Next.js 16 · React 19 · TanStack Query · Tailwind v4 · React Hook Form + Zod · next-intl

items.title: LIKE Admin Panel
items.description: The order management panel for Kastamonu Entegre (Hayat Holding). I built the entire frontend end to end in Next.js and owned the order module.
bullets: Order module across three stages: Draft → Quote → Order
Real-time order locking with SignalR to prevent concurrent edit conflicts
Dashboards sped up by virtualizing 1,000+ row tables and moving heavy filters off keystrokes
Standardized dialog and form accessibility: focus, keyboard, labels and errors
Leaner Webpack builds with code splitting and bundle-size reduction
items.tech: Next.js · TypeScript · Jotai · TanStack Query · React Hook Form · Axios · SignalR

items.title: Karina
items.description: The website of Karina, home of Azimut Yachts and Williams Jet Tenders in Istanbul and Bodrum. I built the whole SEO-friendly site single-handedly — every yacht, price and photo on it comes from the COST admin panel.
bullets: All content managed in the COST admin panel — the sales team updates the site without a developer
New and used yacht listings with brand and model search
Model pages with galleries and virtual tours; listings with full specs, PDF download and sales contact
Brand pages for Azimut and Williams, plus news and events
English and Turkish, with a video hero on the homepage
CI/CD with GitHub Actions; ESLint, Prettier and Husky rules
items.tech: Next.js · TypeScript · Tailwind · React Hook Form · Framer Motion

items.title: COST Admin Panel
items.description: A back-office panel built solo — customers, a product configurator, offers and second-hand listings, with revenue and sales dashboards. It also powers all the content on the Karina website.
bullets: Built the entire panel, incl. Customer and Configurator modules
Config-driven dynamic form engine
Full CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions for automated tests and deploys
Core Web Vitals improved with memoization, code splitting and lazy loading
items.tech: React · TypeScript · GitHub Actions · Lighthouse · React Profiler

JWT auth with cookies; NestJS + MongoDB backend
